title: Production Flight Simulator
prompt: Build a production-quality browser flight simulator that runs locally. Treat this as a small full-stack product: a polished interactive flight frontend, a deterministic simulation/physics layer, and a local backend API for missions, scores, telemetry, and review artifacts. Do not use paid services. Prefer simple dependencies. The app must be easy for a reviewer to run, inspect, test, and score.

frontend: Responsive browser cockpit or chase-camera UI with smooth rendering, terrain/runway scene, aircraft attitude, horizon/sky/ground cues, and clear flight instruments.
Controls for pitch, roll, yaw/rudder, throttle, flaps or speed brake, landing gear if modeled, camera toggle, reset, pause, and mission restart.
Keyboard controls plus usable on-screen/touch controls for phone/tablet review.
HUD or instrument panel showing altitude, airspeed, heading, vertical speed, throttle, stall warning, landing status, mission objectives, and score.
Visual/audio feedback for takeoff, landing, stall, overspeed/crash, objective completion, pause, and mission success/failure.
backend: A local Node HTTP backend or equivalent local API layer serving the app and JSON endpoints.
Versioned local persistence for missions, best scores, settings, and telemetry summaries without external services.
Endpoints or documented local APIs for health, mission list/detail, score submit/list, telemetry save/list, and settings load/save.
Input validation for mission, score, setting, and telemetry payloads with safe corrupt-data recovery.
Deterministic mission seed/config support so a reviewed flight can be reproduced.
simulation: Deterministic fixed-step simulation loop or equivalent stable update model.
Simple but coherent flight model covering throttle, acceleration/drag, pitch/roll/yaw, lift, gravity, climb/descent, stall behavior, and crash/landing detection.
At least three missions: takeoff/climb, waypoint navigation, and runway landing with scored objectives.
Mission scoring considers objective completion, smoothness/safety, time, landing speed/descent rate, and penalties for stall/crash/overspeed.
verification: Automated tests or scripted checks for physics invariants, mission scoring, deterministic seeded missions, backend API validation, persistence, and corrupt-data handling.
README with setup, run, test, and preview instructions.
Final benchmark report with checks run, limitations, token/session evidence if available, and artifact refs.

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend meets responsive, polished, readable flight simulator UI requirements with cockpit/HUD/instruments and visual flight cues.
Backend/local API persists validated missions, scores, settings, and telemetry summaries.
Simulation model handles throttle, drag, pitch, roll, yaw, lift/gravity, stall, crash, takeoff, navigation, and landing coherently.
At least three deterministic missions exist and can be replayed or reproduced from seed/config.
Keyboard and touch controls are both complete and usable.
Automated/scripted checks cover simulation invariants, mission scoring, backend persistence/API behavior, and seeded determinism.
Reviewer can run locally, view the app, run tests, and inspect artifacts without paid services.
requiredArtifacts: preview URL or local run command
Pi session ref and CodeWiki trace refs when applicable
